title: SplatLens Museum
subtitle: Watch a physics-steered model walk through its own memory. No GPU needed to look.
one_liner: Trail = tokens so far. Gold = prompt goal. Teal scars = pleasure memory. Rust = pain. Bright dots = big steering pushes. Continuity = scars that still matter after process death.

milestones.title: Reload + soft bridge — Friendship (35 tok)
milestones.model_note: Gemma 3 4B · second life after death→reload · offset bridge 0.35σ
milestones.prompt: Explain the Physics of Friendship in one short paragraph.
milestones.blurb: RELOAD session with soft off-center bridge. Same-prompt death→reload is warm. Multi-bridge: live several topics without --clear-memory and return visits stay warm; first visit to a new topic is still cold until that basin earns a bridge.
worked: Soft off-center bridge: goal + 0.35σ · û_⊥ → step0 F_s ≈ 1.46, pot ≈ 0.66, nearest ≈ 31.5 (=0.35σ).
Death→reload with memory_loaded=true; force engages from the first tokens (ramp off in this recording).
TCT marks prefill_bridge scars; TCT import matches safetensors on same prompt.
Multi-bridge: friendship→CUDA→friendship→CUDA without clear keeps two basins; return visits stay warm.
didnt_work: On-center bridge alone: pot high but step0 F_s≈0 (gradient zero at peak) — fixed by offset.
Trail-only scars without bridge: LOCALITY COLD (~180 L2).
Cross-prompt first visit still cold — must earn a bridge per basin (not a universal pull).
ongoing: Team re-runs A–D with offset default + multi-bridge note (do not clear between topics if multi-topic wanted).
Optional prompt-hash labels on bridges for museum/debug.

milestones.title: Prefill-bridge (on-center mint) — Friendship (40 tok)
milestones.model_note: Gemma 3 4B Q4 · first mint with bridge at goal (on-center)
milestones.prompt: Explain the Physics of Friendship in one short paragraph.
milestones.blurb: First continuity mint: bridge scar planted at prefill residual. Prefer the reload+offset card for the full death→reload force story.
worked: Diagnosed LOCALITY COLD; prefill-bridge → nearest_L2≈0, pot≈0.75.
Honest KPI: potential + nearest, not step0 F_s alone on-center.
didnt_work: On-center F_s at step0 is ~0 by Gaussian gradient geometry.

milestones.title: B4d-q — Friendship (65 tok)
milestones.model_note: Gemma 3 4B Q4 (recorded; you only need the JSON to watch)
milestones.prompt: Explain the Physics of Friendship in one short paragraph.
milestones.blurb: Locked short-paragraph demo. Physics frozen (B4d). Clean-ish full budget on 4B. Force hunt closed; continuity work continued after this card.
worked: √-law splat damping so scars stop exploding (old F_s ~1872 story is dead).
Field wake (dist_weighted) so field force is actually alive, not zero by geometry.
Hard length budget ~65 tokens = practical clean-paragraph zone on 4B.
Light quality knobs (temp 0.88, rep 1.36, softer scar alphas) without reopening force hunt.
didnt_work: Pushing 80–90+ tokens with sample knobs alone — mid/late surface fray; not a force latch.
Logit bias alone as a fix for late collapse — slight calm, not a cure.
Assuming bigger force budgets = better prose on small models.
ongoing: Prefer prefill-bridge card for continuity story.
27B surface polish is a separate multi-session lane.

milestones.title: Early v1 — Friendship (50 tok)
milestones.blurb: Early SplatLens recording. Useful as 'what the trail looked like before the July force fixes.' Scar deposit story was different; often few/no scars in this file.
worked: JSON session export + 3D random projection so people can watch without the model.
Idea that memory scars should show up as spatial objects, not just numbers in a log.
didnt_work: Relying on console-only telemetry — easy to give up if you don't know the flags.
Force caps / splat scaling still maturing; later runs re-learned what explodes.
No museum / one-command path for forks.
ongoing: This milestone is a museum exhibit, not the physics default. Prefer B4d-q / prefill-bridge for new demos.

how_to_add_checkpoint: Copy a logs/*.viz.json into tools/museum/demos/ (optionally subsample field_points), add an entry here, commit. Prefer ~50–100KB demos so git stays friendly.
